name: imessage-mcp
description: Slack-style context over your iMessages: conversations, group chats, full-text search, photos and real contact names.
long_description: Gives Claude useful access to your Messages history on macOS. List conversations by activity, read DMs and group chats by contact or group name, search every message, see unread messages grouped by conversation, and send to a resolved person or group. Senders are shown by contact name. Everything is read locally and read-only from your Mac; nothing is uploaded. Requires Full Disk Access for Claude (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access). Not affiliated with Apple.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List DMs and group chats by recent activity with unread counts and previews

tools.name: read_conversation
tools.description: Read a DM or group chat by name, phone, email or chat ref

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by name, phone or email

tools.name: view_attachments
tools.description: See the photos and screenshots attached to a message

tools.name: send_imessage
tools.description: Send a message to one resolved person or group chat
